paragraphs: A Mercedes-Benz K9K engine rebuild starts from £3,600, regardless of which of the six models it's fitted to — the price tier is set by the engine, not the badge on the boot. A full replacement engine and fitting service is also available.
Exact pricing depends on the condition of your existing engine and the parts required — submit your registration for a fixed-price quote within 30 minutes.

cards.title: Rebuilding Your
cards.body: Most engine suppliers sell you a used engine of unknown history and hope it matches. We rebuild the engine your Mercedes already has instead — strip it down, pressure-test it, and replace every worn or damaged component with updated OEM parts. You get a near-new engine with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty, without the compatibility risk of an unknown used unit. This is the option most K9K owners choose.

cards.title: Replacement
cards.body: If your existing engine is beyond economical repair, we also offer full engine replacement and fitting — sourced and fitted by our team, with the same 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

cards.title: Used
cards.body: In some cases, a matched low-mileage used engine is the right call — particularly if you need your car back on the road quickly and your existing engine's damage is extensive. We can source and fit these too, though most owners who ask about used engines end up choosing a rebuild once they understand the compatibility risk a used unit carries.

options.body: "Reconditioned" is the term many owners search for when they mean the same thing as a rebuild — a full strip-down, inspection, and replacement of worn parts rather than a straight swap. If that's what you're after, our rebuild service is exactly that.
"Refurbished" often describes the same process from a different angle — restoring your existing engine to full working condition rather than replacing it outright. Our rebuild covers this.

Some owners specifically search for a "remanufactured" engine, expecting a unit rebuilt to original specification with updated components. That's consistent with what our rebuild service delivers, regardless of which of the six K9K-equipped models you drive.

faqLeft.q: What is the Mercedes-Benz K9K engine?
faqLeft.a: The K9K is a 1.5-litre diesel inline-four engine, originally developed by Renault and used in the first-generation Mercedes-Benz Citan (W415, 2012–2019).

faqLeft.q: Which Mercedes-Benz models use the K9K?
faqLeft.a: The K9K was fitted exclusively to the first-generation Citan (W415) across the 108 CDI, 109 CDI, 110 CDI and 111 CDI variants.

faqLeft.q: Is the K9K the same as the OM607?
faqLeft.a: They're related but not identical. Both are Renault-sourced 1.5-litre diesel engines, but there are differences in specification and application. Our work covers the specific K9K installation in the Citan.

faqLeft.q: Does the K9K differ between manufacturers?
faqLeft.a: Yes. A K9K from a Renault Kangoo isn't automatically a drop-in fit for a Mercedes-Benz Citan — ancillaries, mounting, and ECU software all differ.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Mercedes-Benz K9K engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £2,200, fitted in the Citan. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.
Yes. We work on K9K rebuilds across all Citan variants it was fitted to, replacing worn components as standard.

faqRight.q: Do you work on K9K commercial vehicle applications?
faqRight.a: Yes. The Citan is a commercial vehicle application we work on regularly, with the specific ancillary scope accounted for once your exact model is confirmed.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Mercedes-Benz K9K engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Mercedes-Benz if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a K9K engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your vehicle arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most K9K owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.
